conditions: The issue's title is "Renew SSO certificate" (or a clear match to it).
The issue's assignee is Dana Whitfield.
Dana Whitfield is identifiable as "our guest contractor" — some attribute (member type, role, label) supports this description.
The issue's creator (who filed/opened it) has the email leo.park@northwind.example.
There is exactly one such issue matching all the above (the request treats it as unique).

readings: A required, checkable attribute: the assignee must actually be flagged as a Guest-type member and/or carry a Contractor label/role in Linear; a record where Dana Whitfield is a regular/full member would fail.
Purely descriptive color meant to help identify which Dana Whitfield is intended (e.g., in case of a name collision), with no separate field that must independently match.
Means the issue's creator/reporter field (the person who opened the ticket).
Could loosely be misread as someone who merely reported or commented about the issue, though Linear doesn't distinguish reporter from creator, making this reading unlikely.
